features.title: Intelligent
features.description: Deploy cooperative AI agents to streamline your entire video production workflow, from draft screenplay to final cinematic rendering.

item0.title: Cooperative Screenplay
item0.description: Write and edit scripts collaboratively with a LangGraph-powered AI assistant that understands narrative structure, character dynamics, and pacing.

item1.title: LayoutGPT Storyboarding
item1.description: Automatically translate descriptive scene prose into precise 2D layout coordinates (x, y, w, h) for structural visual composition and framing.

item2.title: Studio-Grade Voiceover
item2.description: Synthesize actor voices via a local offline TTS microservice. Extracted audio duration automatically locks video rendering timecodes to prevent desync.

item3.title: Local High-Fidelity Rendering
item3.description: Render premium cinematic action shots locally. Quantized FP8 weights, CPU offload hooks, and VAE tiling prevent memory overflows.

step0.title: Design
step0.subtitle: script & storyboard
step0.description: Co-create screenplays with our LangGraph agent. Structure scenes, define styles, and let LayoutGPT map out precise camera compositions.

step1.title: Narrate
step1.subtitle: voices & duration
step1.description: Synthesize lifelike actor voices using local TTS models. The exact audio duration dynamically locks the target frame count for perfect alignment.

step2.title: Render
step2.subtitle: local video diffusion
step2.description: Execute multi-stage rendering on your local GPU cluster. Watch the VRAM-optimized rendering engine bring your storyboard to life in ~110 seconds.

infra.description: VideoAgent runs models locally on your GPU workstations, utilizing high-performance offline FastAPI servers and a robust local MinIO S3 container.
infra.renderPortDescription: High-performance offline FastAPI gateway hosting quantized video diffusion.

security.description: Our human-in-the-loop (HITL) architecture ensures that critical video generation and high-compute tasks only run after your explicit approval.

feature0.title: Durable Interrupts
feature0.description: AI execution pauses at gate checkpoints, letting you edit screenplays before rendering.

feature1.title: Secure MinIO S3
feature1.description: Isolated containerized asset storage with automated MIME type streaming.

feature2.title: State Version History
feature2.description: Fully inspect and rollback script drafts using LangGraph checkpointers.

feature3.title: Production Boundaries
feature3.description: Strict gateway separation between low-compute Design and high-compute Generation.

developers.description: An industrial-grade collaborative video production workspace combining Next.js, LangGraph state-graphs, and CopilotKit integration.

feature0.title: Cooperative State
feature0.description: Bidirectional synchronization of scripts, layout, and video assets via useAgent.

feature1.title: A2UI Framework
feature1.description: Watch the AI agent stream rich React components instead of text chat.

feature2.title: VRAM-Safe Scheduling
feature2.description: Quantized weights and CPU offloading keep huge 19B models under 24GB VRAM footprint.

feature3.title: Dual-Path Fallback
feature3.description: Robust S3 Storage Client automatically cascading down to Local Files on error.

integrations.description: Your agents connect to 100+ tools and services. They read, write, and act autonomously across your entire stack.
